sanskrit:
द्वौ भूतसर्गौ लोकेऽस्मिन्दैव आसुर एव च ।
दैवो विस्तरशः प्रोक्त आसुरं पार्थ मे श‍ृणु ॥ १६-६॥
iast:
dvau bhūtasargau loke’smindaiva āsura eva ca
daivo vistaraśaḥ prokta āsuraṃ pārtha me śṛṇu 16-6
translation: There are two types of beings, in this world, the divine and the demoniacal;  the divine have been described at length; hear from Me, O Partha, of the demoniacal.
